prompt: The star of the TV show "The Bear" had his breakout role on a Showtime show. The actress who played his older sister on that Showtime show released an album in 2007. The label who released her album released their first album 27 years previous. From their first album, what number did the title track reach on the Billboard Hot 100?
answer:
Jeremy Allen White’s breakout role was Lip Gallagher on Showtime’s *Shameless*. His older sister Fiona was played by **Emmy Rossum**, who released the album *Inside Out* in 2007 through **Geffen Records**.

Geffen’s first album was Donna Summer’s *The Wanderer* (1980), released 27 years earlier. Its title track reached **No. 3 on the Billboard Hot 100**.
